rationale: Train runs of the head (v4.2 with prepPayoff/jackWin targets, definition #20): a third of wins are cashed in with a Jack (jackWin 0.33-0.35 on the bot split against the 0.2 ceiling), so a player adjacent to their King with a Jack in hand wins regardless of the table; the reviewer's distinction between 'I manoeuvred into position' and 'the counter happened to come near while I held a Jack' is lost. This round changes one rule: a Jack may not walk the counter onto a King (it steers; the die or a Joker arrives). Free screen, 63-75 bot games each: jackWin 35% -> 0, lead changes 4.3 -> 5.4, movement turns 13.9 -> 16.0, draws 5% -> 13% (the cost), prepPayoff unchanged (~0.31). Watch draw (band 0-0.1) and prepPayoff; a Jack restricted to the card's own exits was screened and changed nothing.

edits.find: "Instead of rolling, walk the counter one space in a direction of your choice"
edits.replace: "Instead of rolling, walk the counter one space in a direction of your choice — never onto a King"

edits.find: - **Jacks:** reroute — instead of rolling, walk the counter one square the way you choose.
edits.replace: - **Jacks:** reroute — instead of rolling, walk the counter one square the way you choose, but never onto a King: a Jack steers, the die (or a Joker) arrives.
